article.headline: Johni Broome has 26 points and 16 rebounds to help No. 1 Auburn beat LSU 87-74
article.description: — Johni Broome scored 20 of his 26 points in the second half and had 16 rebounds to help top-ranked Auburn beat LSU 87-74 on Wednesday night for its 12th straight victory.

article.story: BATON ROUGE, La. -- — Johni Broome scored 20 of his 26 points in the second half and had 16 rebounds to help top-ranked Auburn beat LSU 87-74 on Wednesday night for its 12th straight victory. Auburn (19-1, 7-0 Southeastern Conference) matched the best 20-game start in school history. Kelly Miles added 13 points, Chad-Baker Mazara had 11 and Tahaad Petiford 10. Cam Carter led LSU (12-8, 1-6) with 24 points. Dji Bailey had 13, and Jordan Sears finished with 11. Takeaways Auburn: Auburn dominated ith its overwhelming physicality, athleticism and depth. It repeatedly used double-team traps to bully LSU’s guards into turnovers and had 18 possessions with multiple shot attempts. LSU: LSU’s only hope at an upset was reducing its plethora of early turnovers, but 15 first-half turnovers led to 15 Auburn points. Key moment Pettiford’s second-chance 3-pointer ignited an 11-4 run in the second half. Key stat Auburn attempted a season-high 80 field goals. Up next On Saturday, LSU hosts Texas, and Auburn is at No. 23 Mississippi. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
